name: CALC-84
subtitle: TI-84 Plus CE style graphing calculator
description: A graphing calculator that reproduces the TI-84 Plus CE, with graphing, statistics, matrices, lists, programs and finance tools.

apps.name: CALC-84
apps.subtitle: TI-84 Plus CE style graphing calculator
apps.localizedDescription: A skeuomorphic TI-84 Plus CE graphing calculator. Every key, menu and screen works like the real handheld: function, parametric, polar and sequence graphing, statistics and regressions, matrices, lists, TI-BASIC programs, finance solver and more.
